text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — we're seeing degraded onboarding/webhook behavior affecting a subset of trial and onboarding tenants in eu-west-1. Elevated embedding ingestion latencies and intermittent 503s since ~04:12 UTC. Created INC-2024-4423.

Ravi Patel: Noted. Any visibility on scope and ETA? Which tenants are impacted?

Maya Chen: Early scope: ~12 tenants (acme-inc, edu-alpha, shopkit, fintrend, med-bridge, two sandbox orgs). Root cause appears to be a misrouted autoscale policy hitting a dedicated pool + aggressive cache eviction that caused request queuing. Eng has a rollback candidate.

Sophie Alvarez: Ops has enabled fallback routing to a warm pool and allowed short-term burst capacity. Eng is preparing a policy rollback patch; deploy in progress. ETA ~20–30m for initial mitigation.

incident-bot: INC-2024-4423 created — severity: P2; bridge: https://meet.redwood/INC-2024-4423.

Jordan Lee: I'm drafting customer comms. Can someone paste a short, non-technical blurb we can send to affected accounts that doesn't overpromise?

Maya Chen: Draft for CS outbound — feel free to edit: 
```
Hi — we wanted to let you know we've identified an issue that may have caused delays or failures for some onboarding/import jobs this morning. Our engineers have implemented a temporary routing fix and we're continuing to monitor. We will follow up with a full update and mitigation plan within 60 minutes. We apologize for the disruption and are offering a one-time account credit for impacted usage.
```

Ravi Patel: I'll tag impacted accounts in Gainsight and queue the outbound messages after Jordan sign-off. For credits: propose a token-based credit (equivalent to affected embedding units) plus an offer for a 1:1 onboarding session.

Jordan Lee: That sounds good. I'll finalize copy and add the credit offer + 1:1 session. Please confirm the list of account IDs once Ravi has them.

Sophie Alvarez: Postmortem owners: Maya (RCAs & mitigations), Ravi (customer comms & credits). Ops will add timeline + mitigation steps. Next full update in 30m or sooner if fix completes.

Maya Chen: Quick action items: @Ravi Patel — prepare outbound seg + credits template; @Jordan Lee — approval of customer copy; @Product Enablement — please pause any scheduled onboarding demos for the impacted tenant list until we confirm stability; @devex — FYI for docs about temporary behavior.

Product Enablement: Acknowledged — pausing demo schedules for the listed tenants. We can offer reschedules after the stability window.

Maya Chen: Final note — please keep replies brief here (status updates only). If you need to join the bridge, use the incident link above. Thank you :pray:

Ravi Patel: Uploaded the impacted-account list to the incident doc and started the Gainsight segment. Will share the outbound queue once Jordan approves.

Jordan Lee: Approved copy and credit amount. Sending first wave now. Will report back with send confirmations.

Sophie Alvarez: Mitigation completed at 04:39 UTC — routing rollback validated, error rate down to baseline. Monitoring for 30m.

Maya Chen: Great. Closing loop: we'll prepare an RCA draft for customers + an internal postmortem. Anyone who needs permission to see the incident doc ping me.

incident-bot: INC-2024-4423 severity changed to P3 — monitoring only.

Jordan Lee: Thanks everyone. Will follow up with customers and attach the short RCA when ready.
